hyperedges.label: Security Risk Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: These nodes together represent the current security posture gaps identified in architecture docs

hyperedges.label: FEAT-001 Resolution Scope
hyperedges.rationale: FEAT-001 Security Hardening resolves all identified security risks and formalizes auth components

hyperedges.label: Auth Data Model
hyperedges.rationale: User, UserSession, Role, Permission, RolePermission, and AuditLog collectively form the auth subsystem data model

hyperedges.label: Sales Data Model
hyperedges.rationale: SalesTransaction, TransactionItem, PaymentMethod, PaymentTenderLog, DailySalesSummary form the sales data model

hyperedges.label: Inventory and Catalog Data Model
hyperedges.rationale: Product, Category, Inventory, InventoryAudit, BarcodeMapping form the catalog/inventory data model

hyperedges.label: Frontend Utility Layer
hyperedges.rationale: auth.js, storage.js, roles.js, sales.js all share the hard-coded backend URL risk and form the client API utility layer

hyperedges.label: Wave 1 Delivery Scope
hyperedges.rationale: Roadmap Wave 1 consists only of FEAT-001 Security Hardening

hyperedges.label: Wave 2 Delivery Scope
hyperedges.rationale: Roadmap Wave 2 delivers FEAT-002 through FEAT-006

hyperedges.label: Wave 3 Delivery Scope
hyperedges.rationale: Roadmap Wave 3 delivers FEAT-007, FEAT-008, FEAT-009

hyperedges.label: Controller Layer
hyperedges.rationale: All controllers together constitute the backend controller layer

hyperedges.label: DbContext Factory Usage Pattern
hyperedges.rationale: All feature controllers inject IDbContextFactory and create short-lived DbContext instances per action

hyperedges.label: Receipt Generation Pipeline
hyperedges.rationale: ReceiptController, ReceiptService, ReceiptDetailDto, SalesTransaction, and Receipt together form the receipt generation pipeline

hyperedges.label: Recent Copilot Change Set
hyperedges.rationale: CASHIER_NAME_FIX, ACTIVATE_USERS_QUICK, and BACKEND_API_IMPLEMENTATION are the three recent tracked changes affecting TransactionHistory.jsx and AuthController

hyperedges.label: Role-Aware Navigation Scope
hyperedges.rationale: App.jsx, Role entity, Permission entity, roles.js, and RoleController together implement the client-side role-aware navigation system

hyperedges.label: FEAT-003 Deployment Bundle
hyperedges.rationale: All components must be deployed atomically: DB migration before API, API before frontend, permissions before controller access

hyperedges.label: User Management Concurrent Bug Fix Set
hyperedges.rationale: Five bugs discovered and resolved together during User Management System delivery; together they form a complete stabilization batch

hyperedges.label: Over-Return Prevention Logic Triad
hyperedges.rationale: The over-return guard spans controller logic, ReturnItem cumulative tracking, and TransactionItem.ReturnedQuantity to prevent returning more than originally purchased

hyperedges.label: RBAC Entity Cluster
hyperedges.rationale: RBAC schema, EF Core mappings, and SQL migration form a cohesive group that must remain consistent; the DATABASE_SCHEMA_FIX incident shows the consequence of mismatch

hyperedges.label: Inventory Audit Workflow
hyperedges.description: Manager records manual movements which update the InventoryLedger backed by the Inventory entity, feeding ReconciliationAudit processes

hyperedges.label: Discount Authorization Chain
hyperedges.description: CashierRole initiates ApprovalRequest inside CheckoutFlow; ManagerRole reviews against DiscountPolicy and approves/rejects via RestrictedDiscountApproval

hyperedges.label: Refund Settlement Pipeline
hyperedges.description: CreateSalesReturn feeds ReturnRefund into PendingRefundQueue; ManagerRole executes SettlePendingRefunds to produce RefundSettlement

hyperedges.label: Authentication Data Flow
hyperedges.description: loginUser in auth_js calls POST /api/Auth/Login on AuthController which creates UserSession; App_Component reads and persists token to SessionStorage

hyperedges.label: Low-Stock Monitoring and Replenishment Chain
hyperedges.description: LowStockThreshold configured in InventoryAnalytics triggers LowStockAlert; ManagerRole performs LowStockReview which outputs ReplenishmentPlanning actions weighted by SalesVelocity
